dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a smooth, concave spline curve bowing toward the posterior.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute tip with minimal pixel radius, transitioning sharply between leading and trailing edges.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-degree incline relative to the longitudinal axis of the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is approximately 1.3 times the vertical height from base to apex.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Low-radius convexity transitioning into a steep downward slope.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, conical extension with a length roughly equal to its basal thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse inflection point of approximately 140 degrees between the melon slope and the superior rostrum surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single, circular, high-intensity pixel cluster (white/cyan) situated on the lateral flank, posterior to the cranial region.
other_distinctive_markers: Luminescent cyan-to-white gradient shading across the lateral and ventral surfaces; digital artifacting or low-polygon geometry visible along the silhouette edges.
